guide.title: How it works
guide.subtitle: Get started with Kymia in 6 simple steps.

steps.title: Start a consultation
steps.desc: Click "Start a consultation", choose a specialty — Kymia Motcho generates a unique patient.

steps.title: Ask & examine
steps.desc: Talk freely with the patient, request physical exam, labs and imaging based on your hypotheses.

steps.title: Pause & resume
steps.desc: Click "Pause" at any time: your case is saved and resumes exactly as-is from your history.

steps.title: Make your diagnosis
steps.desc: Fill in the form: main diagnosis, differentials, arguments, management plan.

steps.title: Feedback & history
steps.desc: Review the detailed report (score, reference course, downloadable PDF) from the History tab.

steps.title: Join the Jury
steps.desc: Every week (Fri 00:00 → Sun 23:59 Kinshasa time), face all clinicians on the same case — the 🥇 Kymia Gold badge is at stake.

rules.title: Simulation rules
items: The patient **never** reveals their diagnosis. Ask the right questions.
Each requested exam is returned realistically, consistent with the hidden condition.
You can **pause** the consultation and resume it later.
At the end of the case: score, missed exams, expected reasoning, complete pathophysiology.
